title: Term Life Insurance Reinstatement Terms by Tier
content:
Each Term Life Insurance tier fixes how long after lapse a reinstatement application is accepted, the reinstatement interest rate, the evidence of insurability by time since lapse, and whether reinstatement restarts contestability.

| | Ashgrove Annual Renewable Term | Ashgrove Level Term 10 | Ashgrove Level Term 15 | Ashgrove Level Term 20 | Ashgrove Level Term 25 | Ashgrove Level Term 30 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Reinstatement window after the lapse date | 36 calendar months | 60 calendar months | 60 calendar months | 60 calendar months | 60 calendar months | 60 calendar months |
| Reinstatement interest rate (simple, annual) | 0.06 (6%) | 0.06 (6%) | 0.06 (6%) | 0.06 (6%) | 0.06 (6%) | 0.06 (6%) |
| Statements in the reinstatement application contestable again from the reinstatement date | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

### Evidence of insurability by calendar days from the lapse date to the application's signed date (all tiers)

| Days since lapse | Evidence required |
|---|---|
| 0 through 31 | none |
| 32 through 180 | statement of good health signed by the insured |
| 181 to the end of the reinstatement window | full underwriting |

Boundary illustration (hypothetical): an application signed on day 31 after the lapse date needs no evidence; one signed on day 32 needs a statement of good health; one signed on day 181 needs full underwriting.
